groups.name: Greeks
groups.why: Each Greek measures how an option's price reacts to one thing: the share price (delta), delta itself (gamma), time (theta), or volatility (vega).

groups.name: Order types
groups.why: These are the basic instructions you can give a broker: trade now, trade only at my price, or get me out if it goes against me.

groups.name: Institutions
groups.why: The bodies that run Indian markets: the regulator, the central bank, and the two stock exchanges.

groups.name: Pooled funds
groups.why: Each one pools many investors' money into one portfolio that someone else manages.

groups.name: Parts of an option
groups.why: The four things that define an option contract: whether it's a call or a put, its strike, and when it expires.

groups.name: Quote screen
groups.why: What you see on a quote screen: the best buyer, the best seller, the gap between them, and the last trade.

groups.name: Units
groups.why: Units for sizes and changes: lakh and crore count money, while basis points and percentage points measure changes in rates.

groups.name: Direction
groups.why: Words for which way the market is going: up for a long time, down for a long time, a sharp rise, or a sharp fall.

groups.name: RBI policy
groups.why: Words from RBI policy days: the rate, the committee that sets it, and the two moods it can be in.

groups.name: Investors
groups.why: Who is buying and selling: foreign funds, Indian institutions, individuals, and wealthy individuals.

groups.name: IPO words
groups.why: Words you meet when a company first lists: the issue, the grey-market premium, how you apply, and the big early investors.

groups.name: Corporate actions
groups.why: Things a company does to its shares or hands to its shareholders: cash, free shares, splitting shares, or buying them back.

groups.name: Product types
groups.why: The product you choose on a broker's order screen: intraday, delivery, F&O carry-forward, or delivery bought with a broker loan.

groups.name: Validity
groups.why: How long an order stays alive: today only, this instant only, until a trigger is hit, or from tonight until the next open.

groups.name: Margins
groups.why: How the exchange and broker decide how much money you must put up, and how much your collateral counts for.

groups.name: F&O limits
groups.why: Rules that cap the size of F&O trades: the contract size, the largest single order, the market-wide position cap, and the ban when that cap is hit.

groups.name: Exchanges
groups.why: Where things trade in India: two stock exchanges and two commodity exchanges.

groups.name: Indices
groups.why: Numbers that summarise the market: three stock indices and the volatility index.

groups.name: Accounts
groups.why: What you need to hold and trade shares: the demat account, the agent that runs it, the depository behind it, and the trading account.

groups.name: After you trade
groups.why: What happens after you trade: the clearing corporation settles it the next working day, you get a contract note, and you pay STT.

groups.name: Returns
groups.why: Ways of measuring how much you made.

groups.name: Valuation
groups.why: Ways of saying whether a share is cheap or expensive compared with its earnings, assets or growth.

groups.name: Risk stats
groups.why: Ways of measuring how risky something is: how much it swings, how much it follows the market, and how deep it has fallen.

groups.name: Risk-adjusted
groups.why: Each one divides return by a measure of risk, so you can compare a calm fund with a wild one fairly.

groups.name: Sentiment
groups.why: Feelings that drive trading: fear of missing out, fear of losing more, giving up, and hope after a fall.

groups.name: Chart
groups.why: Words for what you see on a price chart.

groups.name: Players
groups.why: Types of firm that trade or arrange deals.

groups.name: Research calls
groups.why: What an analyst says about a stock: raising or cutting the rating, and holding more or less than the index.

groups.name: Futures pricing
groups.why: Words for how a futures price relates to the spot price.

groups.name: Bonds
groups.why: Words for how a bond pays you and what it's worth.

groups.name: Data
groups.why: Economic numbers that get released on a schedule and move markets.

groups.name: Rupee
groups.why: Words about the rupee against the dollar, and how the RBI and traders deal in it.

groups.name: Credit
groups.why: Words about whether a borrower pays you back, and what you get if they don't.

groups.name: Results lines
groups.why: Lines you read in a company's quarterly results.

groups.name: Balance sheet health
groups.why: Ratios that show whether a company's finances can take a hit.

groups.name: Sector KPIs
groups.why: Numbers analysts watch for one kind of business: banks, telecom, and retail.

groups.name: Order book
groups.why: The parts of an order book: the full list, the best prices, how much is waiting, and the smallest price step.

groups.name: Abuse
groups.why: Practices that are banned because they cheat other traders.

groups.name: Costs
groups.why: What a trade really costs you: visible fees, and the hidden cost of moving the price.

groups.name: Players
groups.why: The kinds of trader you meet in an order book: the one who quotes, the one who knows, the one who doesn't, and the very fast one.

groups.name: Moneyness
groups.why: Where an option's strike sits compared with the current price.

groups.name: Strategies
groups.why: Standard option positions, each with a simple goal: earn income, insure a holding, or bet on a big move.

groups.name: Option chain
groups.why: Things you read on an option chain screen.

groups.name: Exercise
groups.why: What happens when an option is used, and the two ways it can be settled.

groups.name: Probability
groups.why: Ideas from probability: averages over outcomes, odds given new facts, and events that don't affect each other.

groups.name: Statistics
groups.why: Tools for testing whether a pattern in data is real.

groups.name: Biases
groups.why: Ways a backtest fools you into thinking a strategy works.

groups.name: Factors
groups.why: Factors: types of stock that have tended to beat the market over long periods.

groups.name: Desk jargon
groups.why: Phrases traders use with each other: selling to the bid, buying from the offer, quoting both sides, and having an interest.

groups.name: Trade management
groups.why: Ways to grow, cut or protect a trade as it moves.

groups.name: Warning phrases
groups.why: Things people say when a trade is going badly or someone is trading emotionally.

groups.name: Research
groups.why: Words from equity research: the price target, the rating, the stocks covered, and the call after results.

groups.name: RBI tools
groups.why: Tools the RBI uses to add money to banks or drain it from them.

groups.name: Govt borrowing
groups.why: Ways the central and state governments borrow.

groups.name: Overnight money
groups.why: Rates and markets for money borrowed for one night.

groups.name: Credit instruments
groups.why: Debt that companies issue, plus the swap that insures against them defaulting.

groups.name: Scheduled events
groups.why: Dates the market marks on its calendar ahead of time.

groups.name: Safety rails
groups.why: Rules that stop or slow trading when prices move too far or a stock looks risky.

groups.name: Taxes and costs
groups.why: Taxes and duties you pay when you trade or take a gain.

groups.name: Sessions
groups.why: Trading sessions outside the normal day: before the open, at the close, on Diwali, and at night on MCX.

groups.name: Quote screen
groups.why: What you see on a quote screen: the best buyer, the best seller, the gap between them, and the last trade.

groups.name: Profit and loss
groups.why: Ways of counting what a position has made or lost: in total, on closed trades, on open ones, and marked at today's price.

groups.name: Ways out of a trade
groups.why: Ways a trade ends: a stop when it goes wrong, a stop that follows a winner, a target when it goes right, or simply closing it.

groups.name: Who runs the market
groups.why: The regulator, the central bank, and the two stock exchanges.

groups.name: Greeks
groups.why: Each Greek measures how an option's price reacts to one thing: the share price (delta), delta itself (gamma), time (theta), or volatility (vega).

groups.name: What an option costs
groups.why: The premium is the price. It splits into intrinsic value and time value, and implied volatility is what the market's price says about future swings.

groups.name: Product types
groups.why: The product you choose on a broker's order screen: intraday, delivery, F&O carry-forward, or delivery bought with a broker loan.

groups.name: Order types
groups.why: Instructions for how to trade: at any price now, only at your price, or once a stop price is hit, as a limit or as a market order.

groups.name: Counting money
groups.why: Lakh and crore count rupees; basis points and percentage points measure changes in rates.

groups.name: Returns
groups.why: Ways of measuring what an investment pays you, from the simple percentage gain to the yearly rate with dividends.

groups.name: Company size
groups.why: Market value of a company's shares, and the three size buckets it puts companies in.

groups.name: Money over time
groups.why: A rupee today is worth more than a rupee later, because it can earn interest, and that interest earns interest.

groups.name: Quote screen
groups.why: Prices you see on a quote screen, including the day's volume-weighted average.

groups.name: Strategies
groups.why: Option strategies made of two or more legs.

groups.name: Risk
groups.why: Ways of measuring risk: a bad-day loss figure, market sensitivity, how much it swings, and the worst fall.

groups.name: Spreads that aren't bid-ask
groups.why: Each one is a gap between two prices or yields, not a bid-ask gap: refining margin, extra yield on company bonds, the yield curve, and swaps against government bonds.

groups.name: RBI tools
groups.why: Tools the RBI uses to steer interest rates and how much money banks have.

groups.name: Rupee
groups.why: Ways the rupee is priced and traded: the spot rate, the offshore forward, the forward premium, and exchange futures.

groups.name: Govt debt
groups.why: How governments borrow, and the gap that makes them borrow.

groups.name: Inflation
groups.why: Words about rising prices: the headline number, the number without food and fuel, the RBI's goal, and your return after inflation.

groups.name: Greeks
groups.why: The first-order Greeks: each one is a sensitivity of the option's price.

groups.name: Higher-order
groups.why: Greeks of Greeks: how delta, vega or gamma themselves change with volatility, time or the share price.

groups.name: Return stats
groups.why: Statistics that compare a stock's returns with the market's.

groups.name: Volatility
groups.why: Ways to measure or describe volatility: priced in options, actually seen, the index, and how it differs across strikes.

groups.name: OI patterns
groups.why: The four price-and-open-interest patterns: price up or down, with open interest up or down.

groups.name: Chain levels
groups.why: Levels traders read off an option chain.

groups.name: Sellers' talk
groups.why: How option sellers talk about their trades: selling, selling without a hedge, changing legs, and buying cheap protection.

groups.name: Expiry day
groups.why: Things that happen or get talked about on expiry day.

groups.name: Exits
groups.why: Ways to get out of all or part of a trade.

groups.name: Adding
groups.why: Ways to add to a trade, some sensible and some dangerous.

groups.name: Orders
groups.why: Order types that do more than buy or sell at the market.

groups.name: Benchmarks
groups.why: Prices used to judge how well a trade was done.

groups.name: Multiples
groups.why: Valuation multiples: what you pay for each rupee of earnings, book value, or operating profit.

groups.name: Profitability
groups.why: Measures of how much profit a business makes on its sales or its capital.

groups.name: Cash
groups.why: Lines about cash: what the business brings in, what it spends on assets, what's left over, and what's tied up day to day.

groups.name: Methods
groups.why: Parts of a discounted cash flow valuation.

groups.name: Credit maths
groups.why: The pieces of credit loss: whether it defaults, how likely that is, how much you lose, and how much you get back.

groups.name: Ratings
groups.why: Words about credit ratings and the firms that give them.

groups.name: Bond maths
groups.why: Measures of how a bond's price reacts to interest rates.

groups.name: Debt instruments
groups.why: Kinds of debt: company bonds, short-term company IOUs, bonds with no coupons, and government bonds.

groups.name: Abuse
groups.why: Ways of faking activity or prices.

groups.name: Insider and information rules
groups.why: Rules on using secret information, or on using a client's order against them.

groups.name: Hidden liquidity
groups.why: Ways to trade without showing everyone your full size.

groups.name: Speed
groups.why: Words about being faster than other traders.

groups.name: Fear
groups.why: Words for markets in a scare.

groups.name: Greed
groups.why: Words for markets caught up in excitement.

groups.name: Bounces
groups.why: Ways prices come back up after a fall, and the bet that they will.

groups.name: Shocks
groups.why: Sudden events that break markets.

groups.name: Futures
groups.why: Words about futures contracts and how they expire.

groups.name: Arbitrage
groups.why: Trades that earn the gap between futures and spot, or a fund that runs them.

groups.name: Settlement
groups.why: How trades and contracts are finally settled.

groups.name: Margin
groups.why: Words about the money you must keep with your broker for F&O.

groups.name: Costs
groups.why: Costs of trading that don't appear on the bill.

groups.name: Algos
groups.why: Execution algorithms named after the benchmark they aim for.

groups.name: Measures
groups.why: Benchmarks for judging a trade, and the gap between the paper trade and the real one.

groups.name: Order desk talk
groups.why: What a fund's dealer says to the broker about how to work an order.

groups.name: Probability
groups.why: Rules of probability, including why averages behave well.

groups.name: Tests
groups.why: Steps in a statistical test.

groups.name: Time series
groups.why: Words about data that moves over time.

groups.name: Shape
groups.why: Words for the shape of a distribution of returns.

groups.name: Funds
groups.why: Kinds of fund.

groups.name: Fund words
groups.why: Words used in mutual fund statements.

groups.name: Investors
groups.why: Who invests: foreign funds, Indian institutions, the wealthy, and everyone else.

groups.name: Against a benchmark
groups.why: Words for comparing a fund with its index.

groups.name: Indices
groups.why: Indian indices, including the Nifty futures traded at GIFT City.

groups.name: Exchanges
groups.why: Indian exchanges.

groups.name: Custody
groups.why: Firms that hold securities or settle trades for everyone.

groups.name: Brokers and accounts
groups.why: Who you deal with to buy shares, and the accounts you need.

groups.name: Bull
groups.why: Words for a rising market.

groups.name: Bear
groups.why: Words for a falling market.

groups.name: Levels
groups.why: Price levels traders watch on a chart.

groups.name: Price action
groups.why: Words for a sharp opening move or a price that has run too far.

groups.name: Credit risks
groups.why: Risks of lending money: not being paid, a sudden collapse, and the loss when it happens.

groups.name: Execution risks
groups.why: Risks and costs of carrying out a big order.

groups.name: Options risks
groups.why: Risks that come with options, including the fall in IV that hurts option buyers after an event.

groups.name: Event risks
groups.why: Risks from news and shocks.

groups.name: Measured in time
groups.why: Measured in time: how long customers take to pay, how long stock sits, how long it takes to exit, and how long a trade is held.

groups.name: Percent of something
groups.why: Each one is a share of a bigger total, written as a percent.

groups.name: Ratios (times)
groups.why: Each one is written as a number of times: interest covered, assets over debts, debt over equity, average win over average loss.

groups.name: Rupees per unit
groups.why: Each one is a rupee amount per share or per fund unit.

groups.name: Desk slang
groups.why: Desk slang: an interest to trade, a real buyer or seller on the other side, the market's professionals, and a reported trade.

groups.name: Where you stand
groups.why: Words for your position: nothing, own it, sold it, or hedged so small moves don't matter.

groups.name: Sizes
groups.why: Ways to describe how big a trade is.

groups.name: Prices
groups.why: Prices you see during a trade: the last trade, the mid, your own average fill, and the day's volume-weighted average.

groups.name: Liquidity
groups.why: Ways to measure how easy it is to trade.

groups.name: Sentiment
groups.why: Gauges of how traders feel.

groups.name: Valuation
groups.why: Valuation measures.

groups.name: Credit stress
groups.why: Signs that lenders are getting worried about a borrower.

groups.name: Arbitrage
groups.why: Trades that lock in a price gap with little market risk.

groups.name: Hedges
groups.why: Ways to protect a position against losses.

groups.name: Directional
groups.why: Option positions that bet on one direction.

groups.name: Volatility
groups.why: Positions that bet on how much the market moves, or how much it is priced to move.

groups.name: Biases
groups.why: Mistakes that make a backtest look better than it is.

groups.name: Research room phrases

groups.name: Fixes

groups.name: Trade stats
groups.why: Statistics that describe a strategy's trades.

groups.name: Wait

groups.name: Protect

groups.name: Hide size
groups.why: Ways to hide how much you want to trade.

groups.name: Execute now
groups.why: Ways to trade right now at the price on offer.

groups.name: Auctions

groups.name: Brakes
groups.why: Brakes that halt or limit trading.

groups.name: Surveillance

groups.name: Exchange tech
groups.why: The exchange's technology and the data it gives out.

groups.name: Credit stress
groups.why: Signs that a bond or loan is in trouble, and what funds and lenders do about it.

groups.name: Banks

groups.name: Red flags

groups.name: Quality
groups.why: Measures of whether a company's profits are real and solid.

groups.name: Sell side

groups.name: Buy side

groups.name: Infrastructure
groups.why: The plumbing that holds securities and gets trades settled.

groups.name: Styles
groups.why: Trading styles, named after how long a trade is held.

groups.name: Macro data
groups.why: Economic data released by the government.

groups.name: Global cues
groups.why: Overseas numbers and events that Indian markets watch before the open.

groups.name: Liquidity
groups.why: Words about how much spare cash banks have, and the RBI tools that drain it.

groups.name: Rupee
groups.why: Words about the rupee, its offshore market, the RBI's dollars, and the trade gap.

groups.name: Risk-adjusted

groups.name: Downside-only

groups.name: Selling
groups.why: Selling, or sellers being in control.

groups.name: Passive

groups.name: Order status
groups.why: Updates on how much of an order is done.

groups.name: Taxes
groups.why: Taxes on trading and on gains.

groups.name: IPO
groups.why: Words from an IPO.

groups.name: Account
